Markets.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: Nasdaq surges over 1% as softer payrolls data, lower yields lift sentiment; Nike shares fall
Markets.summary: The Nasdaq surged over 1% due to softer payrolls data and lower bond yields boosting market sentiment. Meanwhile, shares of Nike experienced a decline during the trading session.

Markets.title: Global equity funds draw $34.76 billion, log second straight week of inflows
Markets.summary: Global equity funds attracted $34.76 billion in the week ending September 30, marking their second consecutive week of inflows. The surge was driven by optimism over artificial intelligence investments and softer U.S. inflation, which boosted stock demand despite rising bond yields.

Markets.title: Sebi penalises SMC Global Securities for compliance lapses
Markets.summary: Markets regulator Sebi has fined SMC Global Securities Rs 1 lakh for regulatory infractions discovered during a recent inspection. The penalty addresses issues regarding the mishandling of client order records, unauthorized trading, and the oversight of representative Amit Lilhare's transactions.

Markets.title: FPIs turn net sellers, pull out Rs 35,860 cr in Sep
Markets.summary: Foreign portfolio investors withdrew Rs 35,860 crore from Indian equities in September due to global uncertainties and rising US interest rates. This selling trend continued into October with an additional outflow of Rs 9,232 crore.

Markets.title: French 10-year risk premium soars to highest since late 2011
Markets.summary: The risk premium on French 10-year government bonds has reached its highest level since late 2011 compared to German bonds. This increase reflects investor concerns over France's political landscape and fiscal stability as inflation and energy costs rise.

Markets.title: Keventer, Saroj Poddar groups launch Rs 400-cr real estate debt fund
Markets.summary: Keventer Group and Saroj Poddar Group have launched a Rs 400-crore investment fund for real estate ventures in the Delhi-NCR and West Bengal regions. The sponsors have pledged Rs 80 crore to the fund, which will use a secured debt financing approach.

Geo-Political.title: 'I was not going to let others die' - pilot of Flydubai flight describes cockpit attack by co-pilot
Geo-Political.summary: Flydubai pilot Capt Smit Machchhar told Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi that he opened the cockpit door during a co-pilot attack to let others in. Machchhar stated he took this action to prevent further deaths.

Geo-Political.title: Cornell students gather to voice anger over alleged gang rape
Geo-Political.summary: Cornell students gathered to express their anger following the resurfacing of alleged 2024 gang rape allegations. Students reported that campus tension has become palpable since the allegations reappeared.

Geo-Political.title: I've seen nearly 500 executions - but never one like Christa Pike's
Geo-Political.summary: Veteran Texas reporter Michael Graczyk has witnessed nearly 500 executions throughout his career. However, he has never seen an execution where an inmate survived, such as the case of Christa Pike.

Geo-Political.title: Seoul warns 'further action' if Ukraine does not apologise over prisoner-of-war row
Geo-Political.summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has demanded an apology from Kyiv regarding a prisoner-of-war dispute. He also accused Ukraine of attempting to provoke a war on the Korean Peninsula.

Geo-Political.title: Japan's first mayor to take maternity leave lands on TIME100 Next list
Geo-Political.summary: Shoko Kawata, Japan's first mayor to take maternity leave, has been named to the TIME100 Next list. Her historic leave sparked mixed reactions in a nation currently struggling to increase its birth rates.

Geo-Political.title: OpenAI fires workers for 'mishandling sensitive information'
Geo-Political.summary: OpenAI fired several employees after investigating them for sharing sensitive company data with an external artificial intelligence evaluation group. The company took this disciplinary action because the workers mishandled confidential information during the data-sharing process.

Data & Insights.title: Hormuz crude flows return to pre-war levels, yet oil may still stay at $90–$100 | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: Crude oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz have returned to pre-war levels at 13.5 million barrels per day. Despite this recovery, persistently low refined-fuel supplies suggest that oil prices may remain between $90 and $100.

Data & Insights.title: US 10-year yield jumps to 5.34% as global bond rout pushes borrowing costs higher
Data & Insights.summary: Global bond markets experienced heavy selling that pushed the US 10-year yield to 5.34% and raised borrowing costs to multi-decade highs. Analysts warn that ongoing surges in inflation and energy costs could trigger further market declines despite stabilization from bargain hunters.

Data & Insights.title: AI bubble burst ‘inevitable’, India-US trade ties strained by Lindsey Graham bill, says Finance Ministry report
Data & Insights.summary: India's Finance Ministry warned that a proposed US bill threatening heavy tariffs on Russian oil buyers is straining bilateral trade relations. The report also cautioned that rising oil prices and bond yields could trigger an inevitable slowdown in artificial intelligence investments and capital flows.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Why tax refunds matter for Indian apparel exports
Data & Insights.summary: India's RoSCTL scheme reimburses apparel exporters for embedded domestic taxes. This financial support helps them offset rising operational costs and remain competitive against lower-cost manufacturing hubs.

Data & Insights.title: 'Sustaining growth will require...': Finance Ministry warns of geopolitical, supply-chain risks; projects 7.3% Q2 growth
Data & Insights.summary: The Finance Ministry projects India's second-quarter fiscal year 2027 economic growth at 7.3 percent, following a 7.8 percent rate in the first quarter. However, the ministry warns that geopolitical tensions, supply-chain disruptions, volatile energy prices, and tighter global financial conditions could threaten this growth.

India.title: Maharashtra Public Service Commission Secretary Removed After Exam Leak Allegations
India.summary: The Maharashtra Public Service Commission secretary has been removed from his position following exam leak allegations. The state General Administration Department issued the order terminating his two-year deputation early.

India.title: 700 Detained As Delhi, Mumbai See Big Protests Against Gyanesh Kumar
India.summary: Police detained around 700 people in Delhi and Mumbai during large protests directed at Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Demonstrators opposed the Election Commission's removal of millions of inactive voters from electoral rolls through the Special Intensive Revision (SIR).

India.title: Meet Harshita Goyal, The Chartered Accountant Who Secured UPSC Rank 2
India.summary: Harshita Goyal, a qualified Chartered Accountant, secured the All India Rank 2 in the UPSC Civil Services Examination for 2024. This article highlights her educational background, preparation strategy, and valuable lessons for future aspirants.

India.title: Hyderabad Man Vandalises Temple, Attacks Priest, Strikes Idol With Sticks
India.summary: A man in Hyderabad vandalized a local temple and attacked both the priest and the deity's idol with sticks. Police are currently conducting a medical and mental health evaluation of the accused.

India.title: 'Everyone Trains, This Took Courage': Smit Machchhar's Ex-Colleague On His Heroics
India.summary: Former SpiceJet colleague Teena Goswami praised flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar for his courage in handling a dangerous cockpit situation. She highlighted that unlike standard team scenarios, Machchhar faced isolated and exceptional peril in the cockpit.

General.summary: The pilot of a Flydubai flight opened the cockpit door to let passengers overpower his attacking co-pilot. He has since been hailed as a hero for preventing further tragedy.

General.title: Woman who killed abusive partner has murder conviction overturned
General.summary: Julie Ann McIlwaine had her murder conviction for killing her abusive partner overturned by the Court of Appeal. The court ruled that the original jury was misdirected regarding her loss of control defense.

General.title: Tories aim to be election-ready ahead of party conference
General.summary: Kemi Badenoch has told her Conservative team to prepare for a possible early election. The party plans to focus its strategy on the economy and welfare ahead of its upcoming conference.

General.title: Dolly Parton sings Jolene in Welsh in recording released after her death
General.summary: Dolly Parton recorded a version of her song "Jolene" in Welsh before her death. Her niece Jada Star and Welsh singer Bronwen Lewis shared that the country artist was proud to sing in the language.

General.title: What does Man City guilty verdict mean for their squad?
General.summary: Manchester City's guilty verdict creates uncertainty regarding the long-term futures of their current squad members. The ruling will also heavily restrict and complicate the club's upcoming dealings in the transfer market.
